description: Read a web page as clean Markdown for an LLM: fetches the URL, drops navigation, header, footer, forms and scripts, and returns the main text as Markdown with title, description, language, author, publish date, image and word count. Optional links=true adds the page's links. Text and JSON URLs come back as-is. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

links.description: true adds the page's links (up to 300)

name: web_extract
